description: This file defines the CompiledRoute class in Drupal, extending Symfony's CompiledRoute, and includes properties and methods related to route compilation, such as fit, pattern outline, and number of parts.

classes.name: CompiledRoute
classes.description: A Drupal-specific extension of Symfony's CompiledRoute that adds properties for route fitness, pattern outline, and path parts, with methods to access these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new CompiledRoute object with route-specific parameters, normalizing the pattern outline to lowercase.

methods.name: getFit
methods.description: Returns the fitness score of the route.

methods.name: getNumParts
methods.description: Returns the number of parts in the route's path.

methods.name: getPatternOutline
methods.description: Returns the normalized pattern outline of the route.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object, including additional properties for fit, pattern outline, and number of parts.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes the object, restoring additional properties.
